subject: english
question:
What is the best synonym for “**inherent**” in this sentence?

“The notion of ‘the Author’ is a construct of cultural expectation rather than an inherent necessity of literature.”
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. natural.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"inherent"** means existing in something as a permanent, essential, or characteristic attribute; naturally part of it.

 
 
• **Example:** The risks are inherent in any entrepreneurial endeavor.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, "inherent necessity of literature" suggests something that is naturally essential or a fundamental characteristic of it.
 
• **Natural** means existing in or caused by nature; not made, caused by, or influenced by humans; essentially a part of it.
 
 
• **Example:** His ability to empathize with others seems natural and effortless.
 
 

Therefore, the best synonym for "inherent" in the given sentence is: **natural.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options and their meanings:

 
• **Acquired** (अर्जित): Obtained or developed over time; not innate.

 
 
• **Example:** Her acquired knowledge of the subject impressed everyone.
 
 
 
• **Optional** (ऐच्छिक): Not required; left to one's choice or discretion.
 
 
• **Example:** The additional readings for the course are optional.
 
 
 
• **Imaginary** (काल्पनिक): Existing only in the imagination; not real.
 
 
• **Example:** He created an imaginary world for his novel.
 
 

38:Tedd,

सही उत्तर है: विकल्प 3<
